name: salasty-thrift-closet
description: SALASTY THRIFT CLOSET - thrift clothing store with WhatsApp checkout

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,green,blue "npm run dev -w @salasty-thrift-closet/shared" "npm run dev -w @salasty-thrift-closet/api" "npm run dev -w @salasty-thrift-closet/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @salasty-thrift-closet/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @salasty-thrift-closet/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @salasty-thrift-closet/api && npm run build -w @salasty-thrift-closet/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint:shared-dirs
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint:shared-dirs: eslint --config apps/web/eslint.config.mjs components && eslint --config apps/api/eslint.config.js config
